name: Gates of Orgrimmar
summary: At Orgrimmar's southern gate, timber and iron guard the entrance cut into northern Durotar's red rock. The passage leads from the arid wastes to the Valley of Strength, the capital's busy commons. The gate proclaims the Horde's endurance and strength in war.

sections.title: The Bastion of Durotar
sections.body: Orgrimmar's main gate guards the great chasm cut into the mountains around the city. Towering wooden palisades, iron spikes, and watchtowers fortify the entrance. Travelers coming from Razor Hill and Durotar's scrublands find a grand welcome and a warning to any who threaten the new Horde. Armed Orgrimmar Grunts patrol the approach and watch everyone entering the city.

sections.title: Threshold to the Valley
sections.body: Beyond the gate's shadowed arch, you enter the Valley of Strength, Orgrimmar's civic and martial heart. The tunnel narrows the way for envoys, merchants, and warriors, with sentries watching those who pass. Here stands Warchief Thrall's dream of a secure refuge carved from the harsh desert, where the Horde's many peoples can walk together without fear.

faq.q: Where do the Gates of Orgrimmar lead?
faq.answer: The Gates of Orgrimmar lead from northern Durotar into the Valley of Strength, the city's main entrance and central commons.
Orgrimmar Grunts guard the front gates and keep watch against hostile infiltrators and wild beasts.

faq.q: Why is the entrance fortified with wood and spikes?
faq.answer: Wooden palisades and iron spikes follow orcish frontier defenses, using sturdy timber from nearby lands to make a formidable, defensible choke point in the canyon walls.

faq.q: Can Alliance players pass through this gate?
faq.answer: Alliance members who try to pass through the main gate face hostile veteran guards, ready to strike down Horde enemies on sight.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can see the gates as a place of safety and belonging, a hard-won homeland forged under Warchief Thrall's leadership.
As an Alliance scout or infiltrator, you face one of Kalimdor's most heavily guarded bottlenecks, nearly impossible to breach by frontal assault.
